# Dora

## Overview

- **Age:** Seventeen years old  <sub>[v4 c36 P5](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0005)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021)</sub>
- **Status:** Single (engaged to Ralph Andrews)  <sub>[v4 c36 P3](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0003)</sub>
- **Origin:** East Grafton, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c8 P8](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0008)</sub>

## Appearance

Dora is a fair-complexioned girl with hazel eyes, a straight nose, and a prim, neat mouth. She possesses long, sleek, brown curls that she keeps impeccably tidy. She is physically well-behaved and neat, keeping herself clean and meticulously dressed, often wearing starched white frocks and dark sashes.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P8](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0008), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044)_

## Personality

Dora is placid, obedient, and exceptionally well-behaved, behaving so quietly and primly that she rarely causes any trouble. She is orderly, systematic, and methodical, taking great pride in being helpful with domestic chores and completing tasks with careful detail. Although timid and easily frightened by ghost stories or large animals, she remains composed and devout under stress. Her calm, unemotional temperament stands in stark contrast to her twin brother Davy's mischievous and energetic nature.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v2 c7 P28](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0028), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c16 P0](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0000), [v2 c21 P4](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0004), [v2 c24 P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v3 c1 P0](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0000)_

## History

Dora and her twin brother Davy were left orphans when their mother, Mary Keith, died of a terminal illness. Marilla Cuthbert took them into Green Gables, where Dora quickly adapted by being exceptionally polite, quiet, and helpful around the house and garden. Unlike her unruly brother Davy, Dora followed instructions easily and avoided mischief, though she was occasionally coerced by Davy into awkward situations. On one occasion, Davy forced her to walk a pigpen fence, causing her to fall into the mud and ruining her clothes. As she grew up at Green Gables, she remained dutiful and neat, inheriting Anne's former bedroom in the porch gable when Anne left for college. At seventeen years old, Dora became courted by Ralph Andrews, a former schoolmate.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 c16 P0](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0000), [v3 c1 P0](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0000), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002), [v4 c4 P2](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0002), [v4 c36 P3](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0003), [v4 c36 P5](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0005)_
